map_identity_notes: Google Maps native listing URLs supply the exact coordinate and entity IDs. Guanabanas, Bradenton Beach and Holmes Beach IDs were losslessly converted from the two 64-bit hexadecimal IDs in their native Maps URLs using the standard 0a1209 + little-endian first ID + 11 + little-endian second ID representation. Guanabanas was reopened by query_place_id and resolves to the same restaurant and address. Flower U-pick exposes its ChIJ ID directly in a visible !19s listing link. The older Holmes Beach inventory ID resolves to the current geographic listing; it is not reused as proof of a distinct beach.
publication: Prepared associations; live deployment must be verified separately. Original media stays on Instagram. Share tracking parameters are removed; native /p/ and /reel/ paths are preserved. No new profile-photo hosting consent is inferred.
